title: Add Logistic Regression (LR) as GA Model Type — Expected Brier -0.010 to -0.020

motivation.source_paper: MDPI Information 2078-2489/17/1/56 — Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting (2025)
motivation.finding: Logistic Regression achieves Brier=0.199 on 2024 NBA test season; XGBoost achieves 0.202. LR OUTPERFORMS XGBoost on calibration despite simpler architecture.
motivation.our_gap: Our current fleet best_brier=0.221 vs LR baseline 0.199 = 0.022 gap. LR may be finding better-calibrated probability estimates because it directly optimises log-loss which maps well to Brier.
motivation.note: This is distinct from the mc-dropout and rolling-calibration proposals — those are post-hoc. This adds LR as a GA-searchable model type so evolution can discover optimal LR feature subsets.

implementation.change_type: Add new model type to CPU_MODEL_TYPES and _train_model()
implementation.scaling_note: LR needs StandardScaler — wrap in Pipeline([('scaler', StandardScaler()), ('clf', LogisticRegression(...))])
implementation.calibration: LR outputs calibrated probabilities natively via predict_proba — no CalibratedClassifierCV needed
implementation.feature_selection_compat: Full compat with GA feature selection (subsetting features before fitting pipeline)

code_change.add_block:
elif model_type == 'logistic_regression':
    from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
    from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
    from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
    model = Pipeline([('scaler', StandardScaler()), ('clf', LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=1000, solver='lbfgs', n_jobs=-1))])
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    brier = brier_score_loss(y_val, pred_proba)
    return model, pred_proba, brier

expected_impact.basis: Paper reports LR Brier=0.199 vs XGBoost=0.202 on similar NBA data; our fleet at 0.221 has larger headroom
expected_impact.mechanism: LR minimises log-loss which provides well-calibrated probabilities, especially with many features post-GA selection (50-200 features from 3290 candidates)
expected_impact.risk: LOW — adds one model type without changing others; GA naturally allocates population share
expected_impact.timeline: 1 evolution cycle (~4h) to see first LR candidates in Pareto front

deployment.test_first_on: S11 (exploration role suits testing new model types)
deployment.do_not_touch: S10 (exploitation, stick with best known config)

cross_repo.political_note: Political engine hf-space/app.py already has xgboost_brier and catboost. Adding logistic_regression would give political GA a calibration-focused option.
cross_repo.rotation: Apply political after NBA validation (Rotation C next cycle)
